record.name: Alderaanian Human
record.description: Alderaanians are humans from the cultured world of Alderaan, known for their refined manners, artistic talents, and diplomatic skills. They value peace, beauty, and intellectual pursuits, often serving as diplomats, artists, or scholars.

traits.name: Cultural Refinement
traits.description: Your upbringing in Alderaan's cultured society grants you proficiency in Performance and advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks when dealing with civilized societies.

traits.name: Diplomatic Training
traits.description: You excel at negotiation and conflict resolution. You have advantage on Insight checks to read emotions and once per short rest, you can gain advantage on a Charisma check to de-escalate a situation.

traits.name: Artistic Sensibility
traits.description: Your appreciation for beauty and art grants you advantage on Intelligence (History) checks related to art, culture, or history, and you can identify the cultural significance of objects.

child.facial_features: smooth complexion, small nose, full lips

adult.facial_features: prominent cheekbones, strong jawline, piercing eyes

elder.facial_features: lined face, wispy eyebrows, warm smile

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A refined and cultured Alderaanian diplomat

emergence.description: The nemesis is a fellow diplomat who challenges our character's reputation for fairness.
emergence.goals: Maintain diplomatic relations with the nemesis, while protecting one's own reputation.
emergence.motivations: Prove oneself as a better diplomat than the nemesis.

escalation.description: The nemesis escalates tensions by sabotaging our character's diplomatic efforts.
escalation.goals: Rebuild damaged relationships and maintain credibility.
escalation.motivations: Clear one's name and restore fairness to the situation.

confrontation.description: The nemesis publicly attacks our character, forcing a direct confrontation.
confrontation.goals: Defend oneself against the nemesis' accusations while maintaining composure.
confrontation.motivations: Protect reputation and resolve the conflict through open dialogue.

victory: The nemesis is forced to apologize for their actions.
Our character's diplomatic efforts succeed, and the situation is resolved peacefully.
redemption: The nemesis shows remorse for their past mistakes.
A mutual understanding is reached, and relationships are mended.
escape: The nemesis' actions are exposed to the public, forcing them to retreat.
Our character flees the planet to avoid further conflict.

formation_triggers: Being publicly humiliated by the nemesis
Witnessing harm caused to loved ones by the nemesis

historical_enemies: The Empire's Grand Moffs, such as Moff Jerjerrod or Admiral Piett
tragic_flaws: Their tendency to underestimate the power of the dark side

romance_compatibility: Both share a passion for intellectual pursuits

stage1.goals: Get to know the romantic interest while maintaining professionalism.

stage2.description: Exchange of stories about one's background and experiences.
stage2.goals: Build emotional connection through shared understanding.

stage3.description: Shared activities and mutual support in times of need.
stage3.goals: Deepen trust and intimacy through shared responsibilities.

stage4.description: Romantic gestures and public displays of affection.
stage4.goals: Embrace love openly while navigating societal expectations.

stage5.description: Commitment to a long-term partnership or marriage.
stage5.goals: Navigate the challenges of a committed relationship.

romance_modifiers: Increased charm and diplomacy skills when around the romantic interest
Enhanced ability to understand and communicate effectively with the romantic interest
cultural_approach_to_love: Romantic love is seen as a deep emotional connection, often accompanied by intellectual and artistic pursuits
bonding_mechnisms: Shared experiences in art or music
Mutual support for personal growth and self-improvement

record.flavor_text: Alderaanians are known for their elegant mannerisms and appreciation of the finer things in life. Their world, Alderaan, is a shining example of peace and prosperity, but beneath its polished surface lies a complex history of struggle against the Empire's tyranny.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Alderaanians are natural diplomats and mediators, often taking on roles that require tact, empathy, and creative problem-solving. They value knowledge, artistry, and personal growth, but may be seen as naive or overly idealistic by those who don't understand their perspective.
narrative_hooks: Alderaanian refugees have been displaced due to Imperial aggression
A mysterious event is threatening the cultural heritage of Alderaan
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Alderaanians are naturally inclined towards harmony and cooperation. However, this can sometimes make them vulnerable to exploitation or manipulation by those who prey on their trust.
common_motivations: Protecting their culture and way of life

motivations: to establish meaningful connections with others
to learn and grow in their chosen field of study or art
to maintain peace and resolve conflicts peacefully
ai_behavior.combat_behavior: Your companion will prioritize non-violent resolution methods whenever possible. When conflict is unavoidable, they'll use their diplomatic skills to try and de-escalate the situation.
ai_behavior.social_behavior: Your companion will build rapport with other characters through active listening, asking insightful questions, and sharing their own artistic or scholarly endeavors.

trust_levels: Alderaanian Humans tend to form strong bonds with those they consider friends
Their diplomatic nature allows them to establish trust quickly in professional settings
However, they may struggle to open up to others due to their reserved nature
loyalty_triggers: Perceived injustice or mistreatment of others
Discovery of hidden artistic talents within themselves or others
A personal connection or shared experience that creates a deep sense of camaraderie
